description: Matte React 19 design system (@nocoo/basalt) with Tailwind CSS v4 and standalone CSS entrypoints, layered matte surfaces, charts, and application shell recipes.
rules: Follow DESIGN.md for spacing tokens, typography scales, matte surface hierarchy (L0/L1/L2), and component selection rules.
Follow INTEGRATION.md and packages/basalt/ai/RECIPES.md for AppShell, Sidebar, AppHeader, ContentIsland, PageHeader, and SectionRule composition.
Use README.md, public/agents.md, and public/setup.md for installation, CSS contracts (@nocoo/basalt/styles with Tailwind v4 or @nocoo/basalt/styles/standalone), and machine discovery docs.
Import icons from @nocoo/basalt/icons and heavy subpaths such as @nocoo/basalt/components/chart, @nocoo/basalt/components/date-picker, and @nocoo/basalt/components/data-table directly.
Mount one global <Toaster /> at the application root and avoid duplicating toast containers.
